title: Ensemble Engineering to Overcome Destructive Cancellation in Quantum Measurements
summary: Quantum state preparation can shape how positive and negative contributions combine in correlation measurements, providing a route to control cancellation through ensemble engineering. We develop a framework for relating this control to the prepared distribution, using the infinite-temperature trace of the same operator product as a uniform-weight reference for ensemble-dependent correlators.
